texts.title_text: Jack Welch fired him from GE. He became a Fortune 500 CEO 3 years later
texts.slide_1_text: Jack Welch abruptly fired David Cote, GE's 25-year-old appliance business leader, in 1999.
texts.slide_2_text: Three years later, Welch's decision proved a blessing in disguise as Cote became Honeywell's CEO, delivering 150% shareholder returns.
texts.slide_3_text: Cote's next challenge came when he acquired struggling cooling company Vertiv in 2021, positioning it for digital data growth.
texts.slide_4_text: Despite initial setbacks, including a 55% stock fall, Cote's investment paid off as demand for Vertiv's equipment surged in AI data centers.
